info.description:
Collection gerada do OpenAPI (/docs-json).

1. Suba a API e rode a pasta "00 - Autenticação" (guarda um token por perfil).
2. Rode "01 - Fluxo da OS" em ordem para percorrer o ciclo completo.
3. As demais pastas cobrem todos os endpoints, por contexto.

Variável `role` (admin, advisor, mechanic, stock) escolhe qual token vai no Authorization; padrão admin.
Webhook: X-Signature = sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 do corpo bruto com BUDGET_WEBHOOK_SECRET>; o script calcula sozinho usando `webhookSecret`.

Returns the average execution time of completed service orders

Returns the average execution time of completed service orders. The FROM and TO date filters are optional; when omitted, all FINISHED and DELIVERED service orders are considered.

Opens a service order in a single request

Reuses the client (by CPF/CNPJ) and the vehicle (by license plate), creating them when they do not exist yet. Services and parts are optional. Everything is saved in one transaction: if any step fails, nothing is persisted.

request.description:
Retrieves the service orders in priority order

Without the status filter, returns only open service orders (FINISHED, DELIVERED and CANCELED are hidden), ordered by status priority (in execution, awaiting approval, in diagnosis, received) and then oldest first. With the status filter, returns the service orders in that status, oldest first.
Publicly retrieves the current status and last update date of a service order

Retrieves a service order by ID

The status is returned in the client-facing terms: Recebida, Diagnóstico, Aguardando aprovação, Execução, Finalizada, Entregue or Cancelada.

Generates or retrieves the service order budget

Use this PATCH to generate the budget when the service order is in FINISHED_DIAGNOSIS, which changes its status to AWAITING_APPROVAL. For any later status, the endpoint retrieves the budget without changing the status. Service orders in RECEIVED or IN_DIAGNOSIS cannot access a budget because items have not been added yet.

The selected service order must have RECEIVED status. The mechanic ID is taken from the authenticated user.

Does not change the service order: only the POST registers the decision. The token is signed (HMAC) and expires in 7 days.

Registers the decision of the e-mail link (approve or reject)

Reuses the budget decision flow of the webhook: the first decision wins; repeated or opposite decisions are ignored.

exec: // Assina o corpo EXATO enviado: X-Signature = sha256=<HMAC-SHA256(body, BUDGET_WEBHOOK_SECRET)>

request.description:
Receives the external approval or rejection of a service order budget

Not authenticated by JWT: the call is authenticated by the HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body in the X-Signature header. APPROVED moves the service order to execution; REJECTED cancels it and releases its parts. Repeated decisions, or decisions for a service order that is no longer awaiting approval, are ignored (processed: false).

**Signature:** `sha256=` followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact bytes sent as the body, keyed with `BUDGET_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

Node.js: `"sha256=" + createHmac("sha256", secret).update(body).digest("hex")`

Shell: `printf %s "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$SECRET"` (prefix the hex result with `sha256=`)
